svg.title: The DMA controller's configuration window in Libero, with numbered callouts that light up in turn: the stream input and 64-bit data width, one priority level, four interrupt outputs, four internal descriptors, and the descriptors tied to interrupt 0.
svg.desc: The DMA controller's configuration window in Libero, with numbered callouts that light up in turn: the stream input and 64-bit data width, one priority level, four interrupt outputs, four internal descriptors, and the descriptors tied to interrupt 0.

g.text: AXI4-Stream support is ticked and the AXI4 data width is 64 (the script sets AXI4_STREAM_IF and AXI_DMA_DWIDTH).
Number of priority levels 1; priority 0 is allowed up to 256 transfers.
Number of interrupt outputs 4, each with a queue depth of 1.
The core's own descriptors; stream transfers use descriptors in memory (module I04).
Descriptors 0 to 3 are associated with interrupt 0, priority level 0.
